selection: 逐 Layer 2 輪流；餘量 Common Features 11／Vented Seat 8／Heated Steering Wheel 7／Heated Seat 3，配額 4／3／2／1。選入 10 條，**1 條經 guard() 攔下移出，交付 9 條**

held_out.reason: 其值 `[NOT Pressed / NOT_PSD]` 落在 DR-15 之 token 範圍內

sibling_rows_injected.note: 9 條分屬三個 Layer 2。跨批同型：`RightFrontVentedSeat-023/-024/-027` 與 batch04 之 `LeftFrontVentedSeat-006/-007`、batch05 之 `-010` 為左右鏡像。`ScreenOFF-049~052` 四條同屬 ScreenOFF，逐條比對其驗證對象。

tcs.tc_title: Right front vented seat ignores an invalid status value
tcs.test_item:
The HU shall ignore invalid $VentedSeatFR$ signals, if received.

(Two-state vehicle, medium is invalid)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is configured for two vented seat states, Off and Low and High
2. The Heated / Vented Seats screen is displayed
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CSWM.FR_VS_STATSts = 1 (Vented_seat_low)
2. Read the displayed state of the right front vented seat and record as VS_FR_display_initial
3. Send CAN: STATUS_CSWM.FR_VS_STATSts = 2 (Vented_seat_medium) and check that the displayed state of the right front vented seat is unchanged from VS_FR_display_initial
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_CSWM.FR_VS_STATSts = 1 (Vented_seat_low) is sent
2. VS_FR_display_initial is recorded as low
3. The right front vented seat is still displayed as low, unchanged from VS_FR_display_initial

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列之驗證對象為右前通風座椅之無效值忽略；batch04 之 LeftFrontVentedSeat-006 為左前通風座椅。

tcs.tc_title: Right front vented seat display follows a changed status
tcs.test_item:
When the HU receives an $VentedSeatFR$ signal, it shall compare to the stored state and , if different, replace the stored value with the new value and change the display to the new state.

(Valid status change)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with vented front seats
2. The Heated / Vented Seats screen is displayed
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CSWM.FR_VS_STATSts = 0 (Vented_seat_off)
2. Read the displayed state of the right front vented seat and record as VS_FR_display_initial
3. Send CAN: STATUS_CSWM.FR_VS_STATSts = 3 (Vented_seat_high) and check that the displayed state of the right front vented seat changes from VS_FR_display_initial
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_CSWM.FR_VS_STATSts = 0 (Vented_seat_off) is sent
2. VS_FR_display_initial is recorded as off
3. The right front vented seat is displayed as high

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列送有效值 3 (Vented_seat_high) 且期望顯示變更；-023 送無效值 2 (Vented_seat_medium) 且期望顯示不變。

tcs.tc_title: Right front vented seat switch greyed out outside ignition run
tcs.test_item:
If $PowerMode$ <> [Ignition run], the right front vented seat switch, shall be shown as greyed-out, with a status of OFF.

(PowerMode other than ignition run)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with vented front seats
2. The Heated / Vented Seats screen is displayed
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN)
2. Read the state of the right front vented seat switch and check that it is selectable
3. Send CAN: STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 1 (IGN_LK) and check that the right front vented seat switch is greyed out with a status of OFF
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN) is sent
2. The right front vented seat switch reads selectable
3. The right front vented seat switch is greyed out and shows a status of OFF

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列之驗證對象為右前通風座椅開關；batch05 之 LeftFrontVentedSeat-010 為左前通風座椅開關。

tcs.tc_title: Heated steering wheel turns on when status reports on
tcs.test_item:
When the HU receives a $HSW_Stat$ = [On] signal, the HU shall change the stored status of the heated steering wheel to ON and change the display as specified by the HMI within a time period of <Tdisplay>.

(Status reports on)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with a heated steering wheel
2. The Heated / Vented Seats screen is displayed
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CSWM.HSW_StatSts = 0 (OFF)
2. Read the displayed state of the heated steering wheel and check that it is off
3. Send CAN: STATUS_CSWM.HSW_StatSts = 1 (ON) and check that the heated steering wheel is displayed as on
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_CSWM.HSW_StatSts = 0 (OFF) is sent
2. The heated steering wheel reads off
3. The heated steering wheel is displayed as on

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列送 1 (ON) 且期望顯示為 on；batch07 之 HeatedSteeringWheel-016 送 0 (OFF) 且期望顯示為 off。

tcs.tc_title: Display button turns the touchscreen off and on
tcs.test_item:
The display button will allow the customer to turn the Touchscreen display on or off.

(Both directions from one control)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The touchscreen display is on
2. The Controls screen is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the "Screen Off" soft button and check that the touchscreen display turns off
2. Touch the screen and check that the touchscreen display turns on
tcs.expected_result:
1. The touchscreen display is off
2. The touchscreen display is on

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列驗同一控制之開與關兩向；-050 驗喚醒後之狀態回復，-051 驗訊號送出，-052 驗對影音之不影響。

tcs.tc_title: Display state recalled from the previous wake cycle
tcs.test_item:
When the HU wakes-up on the BH-CAN bus, the HU shall recall the state of the display from the previous wake cycle.

(State persists across a sleep cycle)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The touchscreen display is on
2. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the "Screen Off" soft button, read the touchscreen display state and record as Display_before_sleep
2. Put the HU into a sleep state on the BH-CAN bus
3. Wake the HU on the BH-CAN bus, read the touchscreen display state and record as Display_after_wake
4. Check that Display_after_wake equals Display_before_sleep
tcs.expected_result:
1. Display_before_sleep is recorded as off
2. The HU enters a sleep state on the BH-CAN bus
3. Display_after_wake is recorded as off
4. Display_after_wake = Display_before_sleep

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列驗睡眠與喚醒後之狀態回復；-049 驗同一控制之開關兩向。

tcs.tc_title: Screen Off soft button transmits the display status signal
tcs.test_item:
When the user presses the Screen Off Softkey button, the HU shall send the $TGW_DISP_STAT$ signal. See {CFTS020} for the signal value the HU shall set it to.

(Signal transmitted on press)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The touchscreen display is on
2. The Controls screen is displayed
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator with signal tracing enabled
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Start a bus trace on CAN-B that captures the frames carrying TGW_DISP_STAT
2. Press the "Screen Off" soft button and check that a TGW_DISP_STAT signal is transmitted on CAN-B
tcs.expected_result:
1. The bus trace is running and is capturing the frames carrying TGW_DISP_STAT
2. A TGW_DISP_STAT signal is transmitted on CAN-B after the button press

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列驗按下軟鍵時訊號之送出；-049 驗畫面之開關，-052 驗對影音之不影響。

tcs.reasoning_note: **委派句（§8.2.1）**：`$TGW_DISP_STAT$` 之訊號**值**由 `{CFTS020}` 擁有，非本 Req 之標的；本 TC 僅驗「該訊號被送出」此一事實（§8.4.2）。45 包 §1.1 確認採用。

tcs.tc_title: Display on off does not alter audio or video functions
tcs.test_item:
Display "on" or "off" status changes resulting from customer display button selections shall not alter any audio or video entertainment, information or signal warning/alert functions unless otherwise specified.

(Audio continues across a display state change)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Audio is playing from a media source
2. The touchscreen display is on
3. The Controls screen is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the audio playback state and the current track and record as Audio_track_initial
2. Press the "Screen Off" soft button and check that audio playback continues with Audio_track_initial
tcs.expected_result:
1. Audio_track_initial is recorded as playing
2. The touchscreen display is off and audio playback continues with Audio_track_initial

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列驗畫面狀態變更對影音之不影響；-049 驗畫面本身之開關。

tcs.tc_title: Heated seat icons follow status changes without a press
tcs.test_item:
WHEN no icon on TLM_Display.GUI is pressed but the state of the heaters change, the icons shall change and follow the information received.

(Status-driven icon update, no user press)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is configured for two heated seat states
2. The Heated / Vented Seats screen is displayed
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CSWM.FL_HS_STATSts = 0 (Heated_seat_off) and record the heated seat icon status as HS_icon_initial
2. Send CAN: STATUS_CSWM.FL_HS_STATSts = 3 (Heated_seat_high) without pressing any icon and check that the heated seat icon status changes from HS_icon_initial
tcs.expected_result:
1. HS_icon_initial is recorded as off
2. The heated seat icon status is high, which differs from HS_icon_initial
tcs.dr15_exposed_note: 驗證目標為狀態訊號驅動之圖示更新，未斷言請求訊號之編碼

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列之觸發為狀態訊號變更而非使用者按壓；batch05 之 TwoStagesHeatedSeat-057 之觸發為使用者按壓。

reasoning: 本批依逐 Layer 2 輪流選入 10 條，1 條經 guard() 攔下移出（`HeatedSteeringWheel-013` 之 `[NOT Pressed / NOT_PSD]` 落在 DR-15 之 token 範圍），交付 9 條。驗證目標為右前通風座椅之三種行為、加熱方向盤狀態之開啟、Screen Off 軟鍵之四個面向、以及狀態驅動之圖示更新。值一律取 DBC VAL_ 逐字。無效值依 profile 之優先序取 (2) 配置相依（`4858363` 之二階列舉排除 medium）。**`HeatedSteeringWheel-015` 之 ER 未以 `<Tdisplay>` 為通過條件**，改寫為可觀察之終態（44 包承 42 包 §3.2）。**`ScreenOFF-051` 之 ER 只斷言訊號有送出，不斷言其值** —— 該值由 `{CFTS020}` 擁有（§8.4.2），且 `TGW_DISP_STAT` 於基線 DBC 中不存在，依 §8.7.5(g) 保留來源名不加 `$`。**委派句（§8.2.1）**：該訊號之值由 `{CFTS020}` 擁有，本 Req 僅擁有「訊號被送出」此一事實（45 包 §1.1 確認）。
